title: Gemma outline
body: This is an ambitious project moving from random buzzwords to a specific vision. The outline proposes a modular prompting strategy for a glassblowing design and simulation tool. The planned stack includes React, a visual engine such as p5.js or Three.js, Firebase, and GitHub-connected deployment. The roadmap emphasizes architecture first, then small tested prototypes before building the full simulation.

title: GPT -5.6 Sol
body: The master build prompt describes a glassblowing design and simulation app. It emphasizes a modular workflow, measured inputs, deterministic geometry first, later simulation levels, 2D and 3D views, versioned JSON, testing, accessibility, and clear limits around physical accuracy.
